image_description: A deceased hammerhead shark lying on a sandy beach. The shark is positioned horizontally with its distinctive cephalofoil (hammer head) visible on the left side of the frame. In the background, partially out of focus, are human legs and feet standing in shallow water, suggesting a rescue or recovery scene.
